decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. It includes disruptive elements like Grief and Brazen Borrower to disrupt opponents' strategies, along with countermagic in the form of Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large threats while also having the flexibility to disrupt opposing game plans.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces while utilizing cards like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. With a mix of control elements and explosive reanimation plays, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory through powerful creature threats.

This deck focuses on using multiple small creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent. The key strategy revolves around using creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Delighted Halfling to quickly generate a board presence while also utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of swift creature attacks and efficient spellcasting, making it a strong aggressive deck in the Legacy format.

The deck aims to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. It relies on cards like Goblin Welder, Goblin Engineer, and Fabled of the Mirror-Breaker to tutor for and protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Ensnaring Bridge and a variety of red spells like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt to control the board and prevent the opponent from interfering with the combo. Additionally, the deck features fast mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to power out the combo quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with combo pieces using cards like Cabal Therapy, Entomb, and Grief. It then uses cards like Reanimate and Dread Return to bring back powerful creatures like Balustrade Spy and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Pact of Negation and Unmask to protect the combo and interact with the opponent. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game as quickly and efficiently as possible.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Eldrazi creatures to overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their strategy with powerful abilities. With a mix of cost-effective creatures, mana ramping, and disruptive spells, the deck aims to quickly establish a strong board presence and control the game tempo. The inclusion of cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Kozilek's Command adds another layer of disruption and versatility, allowing the deck to handle a variety of threats. The lands and artifacts in the deck support the Eldrazi theme by providing additional mana and protection, helping to accelerate the deck's aggressive strategy.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Lightning Bolt to control the tempo of the game. Mishra's Bauble and Ponder help with card selection and setting up powerful plays. Wasteland is included to disrupt opposing mana bases. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain momentum to defeat the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro Legacy deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's resources while quickly putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, Nethergoyf, and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck also includes powerful disruption tools like Opposition Agent and Reanimate to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with mana denial from Wasteland, this deck aims to control the game tempo and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Cloudpost lands and other ramp cards to accelerate into powerful Eldrazi threats like Ulamog and Emrakul. Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and disruption, while Crop Rotation helps find key lands like Eye of Ugin. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats early in the game, backed up by disruption tools like Disruptor Flute. The goal is to control the board and establish a dominant position through overwhelming mana advantage and powerful threats.

The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures such as Glaring Fleshraker, Thought-Knot Seer, and Eldrazi Linebreaker. The deck utilizes powerful Eldrazi creatures like It That Heralds the End to dominate the battlefield. Sowing Mycospawn and Territory Culler provide additional support for the creatures. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Kozilek's Command to control the opponent's board. Mana acceleration is achieved through Lotus Petal and Eye of Ugin, while Cavern of Souls ensures that Eldrazi spells can't be countered. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on applying pressure early with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by powerful disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells and removal while maintaining a fast clock with evasive threats. Murktide Regent provides a finisher that can quickly close out games once the opponent's resources are depleted. The mana base is designed to be flexible and consistent, allowing for the deck to operate smoothly and effectively in a variety of matchups.

The deck focuses on utilizing land cards and mana acceleration to quickly ramp up and play powerful creatures like Knight of the Reliquary. It also includes cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to search for specific lands or creatures when needed. The deck aims to be aggressive and disruptive by utilizing Wasteland to disrupt opponent's mana base while also having the potential to assemble the powerful combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage for a quick win condition. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares provides removal options to deal with threats.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures using cards like Reanimate and Grief, and then using Helm of Obedience to mill the opponent's library and win the game. Leyline of the Void helps to control the opponent's graveyard, while cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Troll of Khazad-dûm provide additional threats. Karn, the Great Creator can be used to search for artifacts like Helm of Obedience or Leyline of the Void. The deck utilizes fast mana acceleration with cards like Chrome Mox and Dark Ritual to quickly set up the combo and win the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently fill the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Grief, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm. Once in the graveyard, these creatures can be reanimated using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead, allowing for a combo-style play that aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. The inclusion of control elements like Force of Will and Daze help to protect the combo pieces, while utility creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker provide additional value.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get big creatures into the graveyard, then reanimate them for a powerful board presence. Combo pieces like Grief and Psychic Frog help disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the graveyard for reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces and ensure the reanimation plan goes off smoothly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Grief and Entomb, then reanimate them onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Solitude to gain incremental advantage and maintain control of the board. The inclusion of 4 Brainstorm and 4 Leyline Binding allows for efficient card filtering and disruption for the opponent. The deck also features a unique win condition with Lórien Revealed and Forth Eorlingas! along with a versatile sideboard option in Yorion, Sky Nomad. The mana base provides consistency and flexibility in casting spells across multiple colors.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful combo using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Narcomoeba and Nadu, allowing for Thassa's Oracle to win the game with minimal resistance. Protection is provided with Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, while card selection and manipulation is handled by Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga provides additional support, and Teferi, Time Raveler helps with disruption. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to win the game before the opponent can mount a defense.

This Legacy deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Mother of Runes and Stoneforge Mystic, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth. The deck also includes a Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition for removal and disruption. The use of Aether Vial helps cheat creatures into play quickly, while cards like Swords to Plowshares provide removal options. The deck aims to put pressure on opponents while also disrupting their game plan, ultimately grinding out a win through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on aggressively using the Death's Shadow creature to lower its own life total and grow in power, while also utilizing disruption spells like Grief and Troll of Khazad-dûm to control the opponent's board. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Psychic Frog provide card advantage and selection. Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Daze protect the deck's game plan while also providing interaction. Reanimate allows for powerful graveyard recursion of key creatures. The mana base is streamlined with access to both blue and black sources, with Wasteland for additional disruption.

This Doomsday combo deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary cards to win the game with a Thassa's Oracle win condition. The deck includes various cantrips and tutors to find key pieces like Doomsday and Lotus Petal, as well as disruption cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The inclusion of The One Ring and Lórien Revealed provide alternate win conditions if needed. By carefully planning and executing the Doomsday pile, this deck is designed to swiftly and decisively close out games.
